description: Python library: unified file storage across backends (Local, S3, SFTP, Azure). Spec-Driven Development (SDD).
rules: Use Store.write() for uploads, Store.read() for downloads, Store.list() for directory listing.
All backends support the Store interface; check FEATURES.md for capability matrix (LAZY_READ, ATOMIC_WRITE, etc).
Install optional backends via pip extras: pip install remote-store[s3] or pip install remote-store[azure].
For async workloads, use AsyncStore or AsyncBackendSyncAdapter; see async guide in docs.
Configuration varies by backend (S3Backend, AzureBackend, LocalBackend, SFTPBackend, HTTPBackend).
Streaming reads/writes via context managers: with store.open('path', 'rb') as f: data = f.read().
Atomic writes via open_atomic(): guarantees file appears only when fully written.
Backend-agnostic exception model; see Store API for standard error types.
Extensions available for caching, checksums, streaming checksums, and more.
